headline: As of 2026-10-08: 2,186,424 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 33 of 50 states, D+29.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 2,186,424 early/mail ballots cast so far across 33 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+29.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (448,949), Florida (366,005), Michigan (297,071).
